# Support

For questions about installing, configuring, or using 2FA Login Security, open a [GitHub Discussion](https://github.com/Studio-Lemon/2fa-login-security/discussions).

For reproducible bugs and feature requests, open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/Studio-Lemon/2fa-login-security/issues). Include the plugin, WordPress, and PHP versions, along with steps to reproduce the issue.

Do not report security vulnerabilities in a public issue or discussion. Report them privately at [support@studiolemon.nl](mailto:support@studiolemon.nl).
